svg.title: Five Service Niches, One Brokerage Revenue Rail
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-retained-commission-by-service-niche; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Five Service Niches, One Brokerage Revenue Rail; subtitle: Illustrative retained commission per completed transaction, in USD.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: These are planning assumptions, not market commission schedules or evidence that complexity causes higher fees. Compensation is negotiated for each engagement. Assign each closing to one primary niche so categories do not overlap.; caption: Six closings in each niche produce 30 total transactions and 6 × ($10,000 + $14,000 + $17,000 + $20,000 + $24,000) = $510,000 retained revenue. No separate concierge fee or acquisition spread is included.; stages: label: Straightforward local estate; value: $10,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $60,000 annually. Prioritize clear access, manageable preparation, and an available local representative; still verify sale authority.; label: Remote executor coordination; value: $14,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 14000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $84,000 annually. Coordinate access, photographs, vendor scheduling, and concise status reports for a representative living elsewhere.; label: Preparation-intensive vacant home; value: $17,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 17000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $102,000 annually. Document vacancy coverage, security, utilities, cleanout scope, and who authorizes and pays each vendor.; label: Court-dependent sale; value: $20,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $120,000 annually. Coordinate counsel, court calendars, and buyer expectations; extra procedural work does not establish a fixed fee entitlement.; label: Complex property brokerage; value: $24,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 24000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $144,000 annually. Route title, occupancy, and condition issues to appropriate specialists before treating an accepted offer as dependable revenue.

text.title: Five Service Niches, One Brokerage Revenue Rail
text.tspan: Five Service Niches, One Brokerage Revenue Rail

rect.title: label: Straightforward local estate; value: $10,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $60,000 annually. Prioritize clear access, manageable preparation, and an available local representative; still verify sale authority.

label: Remote executor coordination; value: $14,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 14000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $84,000 annually. Coordinate access, photographs, vendor scheduling, and concise status reports for a representative living elsewhere.

label: Preparation-intensive vacant home; value: $17,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 17000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $102,000 annually. Document vacancy coverage, security, utilities, cleanout scope, and who authorizes and pays each vendor.

label: Court-dependent sale; value: $20,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $120,000 annually. Coordinate counsel, court calendars, and buyer expectations; extra procedural work does not establish a fixed fee entitlement.

label: Complex property brokerage; value: $24,000 retained commission per completed property sale; numeric value: 24000.0; detail: Illustrative six-deal cohort contributes $144,000 annually. Route title, occupancy, and condition issues to appropriate specialists before treating an accepted offer as dependable revenue.

text.title: Assumptions: These are planning assumptions, not market commission schedules or evidence that complexity causes higher fees. Compensation is negotiated for each engagement. Assign each closing to one primary niche so categories do not overlap.
